from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List, Optional

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[Document]

class Document(BaseModel):
    title: Optional[str] = Field(description="The document title, e.g. '《判决文书 1》'")
    categories: List[TaskCategory] = Field(description="The task-specified categories supported by this document's content")
    legal_nature: Optional[str] = Field(description="General legal nature (e.g. Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")

TaskCategory = Literal[
    '行政主体 - 行政检查（监察）',
    '合同，无因管理，不当得利纠纷',
    '渎职罪',
    '劳动争议，人事争议',
    '海事海商纠纷',
    '行政行为 - 行政裁决',
    '行政行为 - 行政受理'
]
